text: wcdraft is a fan-made football draft game. Spin 17 World Cup squads, pick one player per spin, build an all-time XI, and run the full 2026 bracket — free, in your browser. https://www.wcdraft.com/play
Two ways to play wcdraft: Classic with every rating visible, or Memory — ratings hidden until you simulate, and the reveal becomes the story. Free, in your browser. https://www.wcdraft.com/play
You draft a manager too — one of your 17 spins, a real pick that shapes the squad. Most draft games skip it. Build your all-time XI free, in your browser. https://www.wcdraft.com/play
Players from the same nation build Synergy — a live preview shows your XI's connections as you draft. https://www.wcdraft.com/play
Seventeen spins. One pick each. Build the whole XI. Today's seed: Argentina 1986 — spin it and pick. https://www.wcdraft.com/play
